450:t_000:45.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, stay alert. The $$宇宙怪獣$$ will be entering combat range any moment now.」

450:t_000:46.en:
$$ガロード$$
「From what $$ランスロー$$ says, I hear it's a huge army, bigger than anything we've seen before.」

450:t_000:47.en:
$$シモン$$
「If they're coming at us with an all-out attack, we've got no choice but to meet them head-on.」

450:t_000:48.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Damn right. If it's $$バアル$$ we're up against, there's no need to hold back.」

450:t_000:50.en:
$n
「Are you seeing the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$ in the $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

450:t_000:52.en:
$$宗介$$
「But they attack without a word. If we hesitate, we're the ones who die.」

450:t_000:54.en:
$$赤木$$
「If we could figure out what the $$宇宙怪獣$$ really are, or if we could talk to them, the situation might change, though.」

450:t_000:55.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Can't say. If we did talk to them, they might turn out to be total villains, like $$皇帝ズール$$.」

450:t_000:56.en:
$$刹那$$
「Even so, if we could come to understand each other...」

450:t_000:58.en:
$$刹那$$
「Don't worry, $$ヒイロ$$. I have no intention of forgetting what I need to do now, either.」

450:t_001:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「I'd heard about it, but that's a crazy number!」

450:t_001:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Just looking at them makes my eyes swim.」

450:t_001:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Looks like it's only the Solar System-limited kind.」

450:t_001:3.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then I'll lead the charge, since I'm used to fighting!」

450:t_002:1.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That girl... Is she losing it over $$ノノ$$...!?」

450:t_002:2.en:
$$ラルク$$
(If it weren't for these things, $$ノノ$$ wouldn't have to push herself to fight...! Then we could stay together forever...!)

450:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, back up $$ラルク$$! We're intercepting the $$宇宙怪獣$$!」

450:t_002:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Let's go, $$ディスヌフ$$! If they want a decisive battle, I'll take them on!」

450:t_005:3.en:
$$チコ$$
「The $$バスターマシン$$ is scared...?」

450:t_005:4.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Hey...! What's wrong, $$ヴァンセット$$!」

450:t_005:5.en:
$$ラルク$$
「What are you doing, $$ディスヌフ$$! Move already!」

450:t_005:6.en:
$$甲児$$
「What's going on!? What's happening to them!?」

450:t_005:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The $$バスターマシン$$s of $$ラルク$$ and the others have something like a will of their own... Is that will sensing something...?」

450:t_005:8.en:
$$凱$$
「Gravitational field anomaly detected! Something's warping in!」

450:t_006:1.en:
$$シモン$$
「If they weren't summoned by the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, then these guys have finally come to invade the Solar System in earnest!」

450:t_006:2.en:
$$竜馬$$
「It'll be a nightmare if they link up with the Solar System-limited kind! Let's hurry and...」

450:t_007:0.en:
$$カイエン$$
「They don't discriminate at all!」

450:t_007:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What's going on!? Aren't they the same $$宇宙怪獣$$!?」

450:t_008:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Those guys are heading straight for the $$宇宙怪獣$$ over there!」

450:t_009:3.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But... maybe the $$宇宙怪獣$$ I know and $$ラルク$$'s $$宇宙怪獣$$ are completely different things...」

450:t_009:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Or rather, aren't those guys... enemies of each other!?」

450:t_009:5.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$宇宙怪獣$$ from parallel worlds recognize each other as enemies...!?」

450:t_009:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Think about it later! They're targeting us next!」

450:t_009:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「So we have no choice but to fight!」

450:t_009:8.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. The combat power of the $$宇宙怪獣$$ exceeds the data held by this unit.」

450:t_009:9.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you saying they've been strengthened!?」

450:t_010:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The incarnations of endless destruction before your eyes now are beings born for the true end that comes once every 120 million years.」

450:t_010:2.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The meaning of their existence differs from what the incarnation of the darkness of space summoned in the last battle.」

450:t_010:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「They are, so to speak, what heralds the beginning of the end.」

450:t_010:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「You! Are you planning to just sit back and watch from up there!?」

450:t_010:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'm not that idle myself. I have somewhere I must go.」

450:t_010:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I have no use for the $$翠の地球$$, whose land still bears its scars. What I want is the $$蒼の地球$$.」

450:t_010:9.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You may stay right there and taste the end of the universe.」

450:t_011:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Calm down, $$アマタ$$! Fighting the $$宇宙怪獣$$ comes first right now!」

450:t_011:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I think these are probably the vanguard! If we don't stop them here, they'll keep coming one after another!」

450:t_011:5.en:
$$レド$$
「Yeah! I've got something I want to protect too!」

450:t_011:6.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(A one-winged $$ガンバスター$$ and frightened $$バスターマシン$$s...)

450:t_011:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Can we win with $c worn out from one battle after another...)

450:t_013:1.en:
$$凱$$
「No way! So these guys are the main event!」
